function.name: memory_recall
function.description: Recall durable facts you remembered earlier, filtered by topic label and/or a free-text query. Use this when a task may depend on something you were told before.

labels.description: Topic labels to recall (as shown in your memory topics). Omit to search across all topics.

query.description: Optional free-text filter; only memories whose content or keywords contain it are returned.

limit.description: Maximum number of memories to return.
